source.quote: [1] Number of shares issued (including treasury stock): As of September 30, 2026: 5,711,848,120 shares

source.label: Consolidated Financial Report for the Six-Month Period Ended September 30, 2026 (IFRS, Nov 10, 2026), 1. Financial Highlights, (3) Number of shares issued (common stock)
source.quote: [2] Number of shares of treasury stock: As of September 30, 2026: 12,541,457 shares

notes: One class of common stock, priced from its primary listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (9984.T) rather than the U.S. OTC ADR (SFTBY). Shares = 5,711,848,120 issued + (−12,541,457 treasury; signed negative so the parts sum to shares) = 5,699,306,663 at September 30, 2026, from SBG's half-year consolidated financial report dated November 10, 2026; the report states both parts but not the difference. The count is post-split: SBG conducted a four-for-one share split effective January 1, 2026. Shares issued were unchanged from March 31, 2026; the half-year report's subsequent-events note lists only the October 1, 2026 OpenAI investment, no share issuance or retirement.
